title: LibreOffice has an option, called stealth mode in earlier advisories, that stops documents from outside the trusted…
description: LibreOffice had a vulnerability related to its 'stealth mode' option, which is designed to prevent documents from outside trusted locations from loading linked images and other content. When this option was enabled, a linked background image in an HTML document was still fetched during import, bypassing the intended restriction. This behavior was corrected in fixed versions, where linked background images are now properly checked against the stealth mode setting and blocked if the option is enabled.
